No random effect; the state intercept is the reader's proposal. school is the track Hauptschule < Realschule < Gymnasium. year is the wave, fitted fixed; birthyear follows from it (the children are 14) and is ignored. Hand check #162: exhaustive areas group (ACS's states), so state stands against the outside check's design factor; 11 of its 16 levels hold children, 2 to 181 each.
